title: Where Is Kotlin Used?
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of where is kotlin used? using at least one correct term from the lesson.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Where Is Kotlin Used?** as part of **Introduction to Kotlin**. Kotlin targets have different runtimes and APIs; choose JVM, JS, Native, Wasm, or Multiplatform according to application requirements. Use the subtopics—Android Application Development, Server-Side and Backend Development, Desktop Applications—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.

content_blocks.title: Troubleshooting and reset
content_blocks.text: If the example fails, first confirm which runtime/project type the snippet requires. Read the first useful compiler or runtime message, check imports and declared dependencies, reduce the example to a minimal case, and rerun. For target-specific code, use the target toolchain rather than assuming a console or browser runner can execute it.
